agent_experiments.hypothesis: Reduce CFR budget fraction from 0.10 to 0.05 and increase DIRECT_EVAL_WEIGHT from 0.70 to 0.75. Rationale: The CFR prior is trained on only 15 worlds per iteration with simple info-set buckets — it provides a weak signal compared to the direct incremental P75 evaluation which uses 50+ worlds with enhanced card weights, trace-confidence scaling, and early-exit optimization. Allocating less time to CFR and trusting direct eval more should improve decision quality on borderline spots where the CFR prior may be adding noise. The Phase 77 ablation showed the full P75 stack (which direct eval benefits from most) scored best among individual components. This is an unexplored combination that addresses the eval-time signal quality by shifting budget toward the stronger evaluation pathway.
